breaking_news.headline: U.S. Treasury doubles planned long-bond buyback size, pulling yields and the dollar lower
breaking_news.summary: Long-dated liquidity-support buybacks will rise to at least $4 billion per operation from $2 billion for the Sep. 9-Nov. 4 window.
breaking_news.market_impact: 10-year yield fell to about 4.651%, DXY to about 98.85 and U.S. equities stabilized.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Lower long yields support Taiwan high-duration AI valuations, but relief remains vulnerable to inflation and oil.

breaking_news.headline: Fed July minutes show deeper inflation concern and conditional support for higher rates
breaking_news.summary: Several policymakers were ready to raise rates in July and many judged tightening likely if inflation fails to decline toward 2%.
breaking_news.market_impact: Keeps the medium-term rate ceiling elevated despite Wednesday's bond rally.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: AI valuation relief may be fragile if inflation or oil keeps the Fed hawkish.

breaking_news.headline: Oil reaches near four-week high as Middle East supply risk persists
breaking_news.summary: WTI settled at $85.83 and Brent at $91.62 as supply-risk premium stayed elevated.
breaking_news.market_impact: Adds inflation risk and limits how far long yields can sustainably fall.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Macro headwind for tech multiples if oil continues higher.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Google expands custom-AI-chip work with Marvell
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Marvell jumped about 9.9% on a broad Google TPU-related custom-silicon agreement while Broadcom fell.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Highlights hyperscaler supplier diversification and continuing ASIC demand.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Positive structural read-through for advanced foundry, packaging, networking, PCB and server supply chains.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Samsung raises some advanced foundry prices up to 15% as AI demand tightens capacity
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Selected 4nm, 5nm and 8nm foundry services saw price increases as customers sought capacity alternatives.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Confirms strong AI-driven foundry demand and pricing power.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Constructive for TSMC pricing and advanced-packaging ecosystems while competition remains a watch item.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Megacap tech rebounds as yields ease
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Apple gained 2.19%, Microsoft 0.56%, while Nvidia was roughly flat.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Shows rotation rather than a full return to broad AI beta.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Positive for Apple-linked suppliers; TSMC and AI hardware opening still require TSM ADR and TX confirmation.

narration_points: 美股結束三連跌小幅反彈，主因美國財政部擴大長債回購，十年債殖利率回落至約4.65%。
但聯準會七月會議紀要顯示，若通膨不回落，多位官員仍認為需要升息，利率風險尚未解除。
AI主線出現新的ASIC訊號：Google擴大與Marvell的客製AI晶片合作，三星也因AI需求調高部分先進製程代工價格。
對台股而言，先進製程、CoWoS、AI伺服器、網通、PCB、散熱與電源仍是主要觀察族群，但高油價可能限制估值擴張。
